scope: commands.py/streaming.py API capability discovery and bounded cloud control/queue qualification; not UI recreation or full parity
reproduction: uv run --extra web --extra test --extra cli --with playwright python scripts/claude-rc-command-smoke --qualify-controls --capture-web-catalog --output <new-evidence.json>

reuse.upstream_inspected: upstream/main fac6d28eb1cf797f95abe22ee95b7f23fb246e4d: existing message/watch examples and client; no command capability enumeration or genuine question-boundary queue acceptance script
reuse.prior_contracts: Reused API_REFERENCE.md and group05 live/independent evidence, existing commands dispatch, streaming correlation, prompt owner, and claude-rc-permission-smoke collect/tool_results helpers. No new transport, poller, service, credential owner or UI renderer.
reuse.current_discovery: Actual signed-in Code web composer on owned sessions plus fresh worker initialize. Public bundle inspection exposed a DIFFERENT shared chat/desktop port/explain/refuse registry; it was not substituted for the observed Code composer catalog. Existing captured cloud admission policy remains intact.

implementation: command_capabilities(session_id, timeout=15, local_handlers=None) performs one initialize and separates captured web names, actual worker names/aliases, API routes and host-required/unsupported reasons. available means dispatchable, not proven execution.
claude-rc dispatch SESSION --capabilities executes enumeration without dispatching a slash prompt. Existing typed/advertised dispatch and admission gates remain the only write paths.
Captured 22 Code menu names, including advisor after the session has run; design/slides are absent from that menu despite appearing in the 55-name worker harness catalog.

status/autocompact now fail locally without explicit handlers even when worker-advertised. Reasons identify status presentation and the absence of an admitted cloud autocompact-setting control. Sandbox keeps its cloud-rejected host-dialog reason.

send_and_collect no longer terminates on an earlier turn's question while its own message is queued. Both results and blocking prompts require the exact owned message's processing receipt, with recovered-history timestamp ordering enforced.
New optional live smoke owns a fresh explicit workspace environment/session, and optionally one dev CDP tab; it proves actual tool results/reads/continuations and exact cleanup.
live_qualified: Current Code composer menu equals the captured 22-name web catalog exactly; full 55-name worker command advertisement and start_shell_task_v1 capability recorded separately.

Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5: applied.model equality, exact MODEL_PROOF_OK assistant reply, matching assistant message model, own-message receipt checked by existing collector and real successful result IDs.
plan/acceptEdits/default: worker verdict and independent initialize permission-mode equality.

Effort low, fast true/false, advisor model/off, thinking false/true and view verbose/normal: independent effective flag-layer reads; advisor applied readback also matched. Normal view and advisor off normalize to absent/null settings.
Cost, absent plan, hooks listing, permission rules and binary version: actual worker reply shapes, not event enqueue acknowledgements. No private setting/rule bodies logged.

Worker read_file returns generated exact bytes. seed_read_state on a distinct file never read through the worker is followed by a correlated successful Edit with no Read invocation, then exact updated worker file readback. Earlier runs also independently read these bytes through controller files.

At a genuine AskUserQuestion boundary, an exact UUID is queued with null processing fields, cancel_async_message returns cancelled:true, the exact question receives its answer/tool-result, no cancelled output is generated, and a subsequent marker turn completes.

Legacy interrupt at a genuine question: exact question tool-use ID receives an error tool-result, the intended post-answer write is absent from the worker directory and controller GET returns 404, and a fresh AFTER_INTERRUPT_OK turn completes. This is not interrupt_receipt_v1 proof.
important_protocol_distinction: Cancelled queue envelopes later acquired processing_at/processed_at timestamps even though the worker returned cancelled:true and did not execute the queued prompt. Transport processing timestamps alone do not establish model inference or invalidate cancellation.
remaining_limitations: Only start_shell_task_v1 was advertised; the captured cloud gate rejects start_shell_task. No new bypass was added.

Send-now, priority race variants, interrupt_receipt_v1 and task messaging remain unqualified: no matching advertised cloud task/receipt fixture. Absence of advertisement is not proof the platform can never support them.
Flag-layer persistence/readback does not prove fast/advisor/thinking inference behavior or rendered view changes.
file_suggestions returned an empty list in these no-repository fixtures; nonempty search results and nonempty plan content are not qualified.
Seed then Edit without Read is a positive continuation proof, not a controlled causal comparison against every unseeded edit behavior.
Worker-advertised prompt commands retain the prior recap execution proof; the new snapshot does not claim all 55 worker commands were executed.

Host-local configuration/authentication/presentation requires a host handler; renderer absence is not a new web API defect. No artifact, login/logout, feedback, connector or external-side-effect command was executed.

A controller-file GET 404 after a successful worker read remains unexplained in one combined-control run. Final command qualification uses the owning worker read_file/directory protocol rather than claiming controller file sync parity.

retained_failures.resolution: Preserved failure; final read-state proof uses worker-owned read_file and directory observations. No claim that controller sync timing or mapping was fixed.

evidence_sanitization: Historical duplicate routing tables and worker descriptions removed by a local redactor; original SHA256 recorded. Checks, exact created IDs and cleanup unchanged. Final primary snapshot is complete.
